reference.question: Which expression cannot be used to write \(\cos 2\alpha\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Recognize the double-angle expression

\(2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\) is \(\sin 2\alpha\), not \(\cos 2\alpha\).
